rationale: The original short thesis relied on the $60.00 session VWAP acting as resistance, but price has reclaimed both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($59.85) and VWAP, printing higher lows and closing at $60.08 on the latest 1-minute candle. Although the negative earnings catalyst and 25 bps spread make flipping to a long position unattractive, the structural rejection at $60.00 has failed, justifying an immediate exit before the $60.45 invalidation is reached.
